comments.admin: Public key of the admin who can update program parameters
comments.treasury: Public key where protocol fees will be sent
comments.matcher: Optional: Set to a specific pubkey to restrict matching to that address only
comments.pythConfidenceTolBps: Maximum allowed Pyth price confidence in basis points (500 = 5%)
comments.pythMaxStalenessSlots: Maximum staleness of Pyth price in slots
comments.feeBpsLimit: Maximum fee rate allowed in basis points (5000 = 50%)
comments.minBaseLot: Minimum order size for base token in lots (with decimals)
comments.minQuoteLot: Minimum order size for quote token in lots (with decimals)
comments.makerFeeBps: Fee for maker orders in basis points (0 = free)
comments.takerFeeBps: Fee for taker orders in basis points (30 = 0.3%)
comments.pythPriceFeed: Optional: Pyth price feed account for this market
